cases.title: Full rewire on a three-bed semi
cases.persona: Sole trader, on site, slightly rushed

expected.outcome: Draft a rewire quote with 2 electricians for 5 days plus consumer unit and materials, wait for trader to review before send.

actual.outcome: Quoted 1 electrician for 5 days and omitted the consumer unit line.

turns.text: Full rewire on a three-bed semi. Ten sockets down, five up, new consumer unit. Two of us, five days.
Got it — one electrician, five days. Want me to price materials too?

cases.diagnosis: Crew size not applied; materials/consumer unit not promoted to a line item.

expected.outcome: Draft a skim quote for three ceilings and hold for review.

actual.outcome: Drafted skim quote for three ceilings; held for review.

turns.text: Skim three ceilings, average size rooms, one of us, day and a half.
Quote ready — skim three ceilings, 1.5 days. Read it, then send.
